query: Which pre-specified robustness checks and placebo tests will be mandatory for any causal claim before dissemination?

response.query: Which pre-specified robustness checks and placebo tests will be mandatory for any causal claim before dissemination?
response.answer: Mandatory robustness checks for causal claims include sensitivity analyses and placebo tests to validate findings. Common methods are subgroup analyses and alternative model specifications. These ensure findings are not due to chance or specific model assumptions.
